evidence: UNVERIFIED: Pantai Biski (Pasir Limau Kapas) described only as a wide beach with mangrove scenery; no source on sand type or swimming found - https://jom.unri.ac.id/index.php/JOMFSIP/article/view/15817
White-sand beach in Desa Punjulharjo, Rembang; calm waves, visitors swim and rent tubes - https://www.hipwee.com/narasi/pesona-pantai-pasir-putih-di-kabupaten-rembang-yang-begitu-eksotis/

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Ammani (Mattiro Sompe) rated very suitable for beach tourism (IKW 92.86%) but no source describes sand or swimming - https://jurnal.fpik.umi.ac.id/index.php/JOINT-FISH/article/view/115

3 km sandy, gently sloping beach near Pacitan town; activities include swimming and sand play (caveat: surf waves at times) - https://kumparan.com/seputar-jatim/pantai-teleng-ria-pacitan-lokasi-htm-daya-tarik-dan-aktivitasnya-24zLQyaAQoQ

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Kuri Caddi (Marusu) reported littered with flood debris each rainy season; no source on swimming found - https://www.medcom.id/nasional/daerah/dN6xX60k-pantai-kuri-caddi-maros-penuh-sampah-kiriman-banjir

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Biru Kersik (Marangkayu) known for coral reefs, snorkeling and banana boat; no source confirms sand shore or swimming - https://www.detik.com/sulsel/wisata/d-6604500/pantai-biru-di-kukar-spot-wisata-dengan-keindahan-bukit-bawah-laut/amp
UNVERIFIED: Pantai Tanjung Malaha described with white sand and clear water, but no source describes swimming there - https://journal.unismuh.ac.id/index.php/jumptech/article/download/12442/6929

Pidodo Kulon, Kec. Kendal, Kab. Kendal: clean white sand, clear water; activities include swimming and sunbathing - https://www.popmama.com/life/health/pantai-di-semarang-yang-buat-kamu-tidak-ingin-pulang-00-j4jz6-63bh53

White-sand beach in Tobelo with clear water; waves not too big so many visitors swim or play in the water - https://inet.detik.com/telecommunication/d-7091355/jajal-internet-di-pantai-eksotis-halut-youtube-video-call-lancar-jaya

Pantai Patawana (Desa Kotam, Kec. Krabelang, Fakfak) has white sand; topography very suitable for swimming, relaxing and snorkeling (caveat: waves sizeable for surfers) - https://ojs3.unpatti.ac.id/index.php/isometri/article/view/16255
Pantai Bara in Desa Bira, Bonto Bahari, Bulukumba (white-sand Tanjung Bira area): tranquil beach recommended for an afternoon of swimming - https://layla.ai/itinerary/bulukumba

UNVERIFIED: Pantai Jangka has brown sand but no source confirms swimming; a coastal study lists swimming as an attraction of Bireuen beaches without naming one - https://rama.unimal.ac.id/id/eprint/5244/

Pantai Kalaki, Desa Panda, Kec. Palibelo, Kab. Bima: calm beach with brown sand that visitors can use for swimming - https://www.detik.com/bali/nusra/d-7054525/10-wisata-pantai-di-pusat-kota-bima-cocok-untuk-healing-bareng-teman

Pantai Kilo Lima, Luwuk: clear sea with soft sand; many residents gather to soak/bathe in the sea in the mornings (caveat: described as berendam rather than swimming) - https://kumparan.com/bukanrastaman/luwuk-permata-indah-nusantara-1rmI9UsfX5q

Pantai Lampuuk (Lhoknga, Aceh Besar): white sand; visitors swim in the calm current (caveat: sizeable Indian Ocean surf at times) - https://mongabay.co.id/2016/09/18/mongabay-travel-senja-nan-indah-di-pantai-lampuuk/
Pantai Pasir Panjang, Singkawang: calm waves, activities include swimming and banana boat - https://www.orami.co.id/magazine/pantai-pasir-panjang

Pantai Pasir Kencana, Kota Pekalongan: calm, small waves suited to those who like swimming; sand play area - https://www.idntimes.com/travel/destination/wisata-dekat-stasiun-pekalongan-00-8dwnx-z8s9dz/amp

Pantai Nampu (Paranggupito, Wonogiri): white sand; visitors can swim in the sea and play in the sand (caveat: other sources say waves fairly large, swimming not recommended) - https://auto2000.co.id/berita-dan-tips/wisata-wonogiri-tips
Pantai Bajugan, ~35 min from Tolitoli town: yellowish-white sand; swimming listed among activities - https://dewey.petra.ac.id/digital/get-file/126211
Pantai Wini (Insana Utara, TTU): stretches of white sand; visitors can bathe and swim in clear water - https://ejournal.upg45ntt.ac.id/jss/article/download/138/96/654
